packageRules.description: The step-redox CAD tooling requires cadquery-ocp==8.0.1.1.0, which publishes CPython wheels only through cp314; do not propose cp315 until a compatible CAD wheel is available

getrandom 0.3 is still used transitively by ahash 0.8 on wasm32; the renamed wasm_js 0.3 feature bridge must not be upgraded to 0.4 (which is already directly present and duplicates Cargo dependencies)
